name: Vibentra v1.4.6 - Precision Audio Match & Authentic YouTube Playback
changelog: 🎯 Authentic Audio Playback: Fixed track mismatch bug where YouTube Music songs (e.g. Mandaadi) were hijacked by unrelated regional tracks. Direct high-fidelity playback with strict artist/title verification.
🎨 Clear Search Experience: Warm dark theme, golden-yellow headers, grouped Songs, Videos, Albums, Artists and Playlists
🎵 Audio-First Video Engine: YouTube video songs stream directly via audio player with album art preserved
✨ Scalloped Music Player Redesign: 12-lobed rosette flower play button, white squircle download & favorite actions, and slate-navy gradient
⚡ Precision Relevance Scoring: Instant match for songs, playlists, albums and song artists
